paper_verdict.estimator_family: GMM-system (xtabond2 system GMM, lagged dependent variable, robust SE)
paper_verdict.pooling_concerns: Outcome is ln TFP (Tornqvist, or DEA-Malmquist-based) in logs, regressors are percentage shares (e-government, e-commerce, household internet), so coefficients are semi-elasticities of tiny size with SE printed as 0.000 (precision lost). Dynamic model with lagged dependent variable: coefficients are short-run, not long-run. Regions (182 NUTS regions in 27 countries), not countries; 9 countries enter as one unit. Table 4 estimates are on log products of two shares (interactions), not comparable to single-technology effects, and use 2266 obs. Digital proxies not instrumented; paper disclaims causality. Table 3 cols (7) and (10) print both contemporaneous and lagged internet terms. Table 4 col (15) prints '0077***'.

estimates.note: Table 3 col (1); table note: robust standard errors in parentheses; 2362 obs; n_countries null but table prints Regions 182 (27 countries per Table A1). e-government use is an ICT-use proxy recorded as 'other'.
